## How it was checked

- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make e2e`, for changes to the web app (needs `make api` running)
- [ ] Screenshots in the light and the dark theme, for visible changes

## Content and safety

- [ ] No scripture, Sanskrit or translation is typed into the interface or the prompts; it comes from the corpus
- [ ] Source text, translator's notes, editorial material and AI interpretation stay labelled and distinct
- [ ] Changes to the corpus or the curated data were rebuilt with `make corpus`, and its validation report reviewed
